applies_to.quote: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Prudential Norms on Capital Adequacy) Twelfth Amendment Directions, 2026

answer.action: Commercial banks must update risk weight calculations for QCCP trade exposures and adjust CVA loss calculations for default exposure determinations.
answer.action_quote: Accordingly, a bank shall use the amount recognised in its financial statements in accordance with its applicable accounting and valuation policies.

effective_date.quote: These Amendment Directions shall come into effect from the date of issue.

answer.amends: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks - Prudential Norms on Capital Adequacy) Directions, 2025
